name: Preparatory Physics Laboratory - I
description: The course consists of a total of eight experiments -- three Foundational and five Core -- covering mechanics, waves and oscillations, and thermal physics. Foundational experiments build error analysis and uncertainty quantification, precision measurements with the Vernier caliper and screw gauge, and determination of gravitational acceleration g with the simple pendulum. Core experiments build on this through lab reports and viva, covering data collection, analysis and interpretation — examining Newton's second law via an inclined plane with friction, Conservation laws via a ballistic pendulum and loop-the-loop, Oscillatory motion via a helical spring and sonometer, and Thermodynamics via analysis of Gas Laws.
